claims.title: Claims
claims.body: Answer a claim when Packio asks
claims.answerBody: Accept it, or explain with evidence; Packio decides once you answer.

respond.disputeHint: Explain what happened, e.g. produced to the approved proof
respond.acceptHint: How you will put it right (optional)
respond.noteRequired: Please explain in at least 3 characters
respond.acceptBody: You accept {no} is your factory's; Packio may deduct it or ask for a reprint.
respond.disputeBody: Send your side of {no} for Packio to decide.
respond.notePlaceholder: e.g. We will remake 40 boxes and ship by 20 Oct
respond.acceptMeans: You agree the factory is responsible — Packio will ask for a remake or deduct from your payout, as the customer asked
respond.disputeMeans: Tell Packio the factory is not at fault, with reasons and photos — Packio decides after reading it
respond.disputePlaceholder: e.g. All boxes left dry and complete, photos at hand-over; damage likely in transit

claims.deductionTotal: Deducted from the factory in all {amount}
claims.answerOverdue: Past the answer time ({at}) — Packio may decide without the factory's explanation

performance.title: Your performance
performance.body: The monthly numbers Packio allocates jobs by
performance.currentNote: {month} is still running; its numbers settle at month end
performance.trendSoon: The trend appears once there are at least two months of figures

users.title: Users and roles
users.body: Who acts for your factory, and what each can do
users.name: Name

roleHints.factory_planner: Accepts and plans jobs; sees the scorecard
roleHints.factory_purchaser: Looks after suppliers and drafts purchase orders
roleHints.factory_maintenance: Breakdowns, maintenance plans and spare parts
roleHints.factory_sales: Customers, quotations, sales orders and delivery notes
roleHints.factory_auditor: Read the books, statements, tax and the documents behind them (read-only)

users.deactivateBody: {name} can no longer sign in for your factory until reactivated.
users.reactivateBody: {name} can sign in for your factory again.
users.created: User added. Give them their first password yourself
users.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Hand it over by phone or in person, and have them change it at first sign-in
users.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 12 characters
users.createBody: A new user can sign in at once with the first password you set; no invitation e-mail is sent.
users.ownerManaged: Owners are managed by Packio's partner team
users.editRolesBody: Pick one or more; the menu follows the roles chosen

notifications.lineNotLinked: LINE is not linked — LINE notices turn on once it is.

push.unconfigured: Device notices are not set up here
push.denied: Notices are blocked in the browser's settings

categoryHints.transactional: New jobs, shipments, statements, payouts and claims — e-mail stays on
categoryHints.security: Sign-ins and role changes — always on, on every channel

settings.title: Settings
settings.notificationsBody: Yours only; others keep their own
settings.themeHint: Use high contrast where the floor is bright
settings.hoursBody: The factory's working time and the days it closes
settings.erpBody: Warehouses, document numbers and stock rules
settings.supportBody: Let the Packio team read your ERP dashboard and settings for up to 7 days, and see who looked when
settings.profileBody: Company details, documents, payout account, capabilities and agreements — view them here; ask the Partner team to change them

hours.title: Working hours
hours.body: The factory's hours set the acceptance deadlines and ship dates of new jobs
hours.platformDefault: Packio's standard hours apply for now
hours.upcoming: The hours you set apply from {dates}; until then the current hours stay
hours.effect: Applies to new jobs from that day: closed days do not count for acceptance deadlines and ship dates. Accepted jobs keep their dates
hours.readOnly: Only the factory owner can change the hours

closures.title: Holidays and closures
closures.body: Public holidays and the days the factory closes do not count as working days
